It is ≈0.56 from the ring's pose (hole ellipse ≈0.25 plus the ~20° tilt of a chevron ring resting V-down) and ≈0.8 from the crackle-orientation isotropy. - At phone size the ring looks nearly as wide as the leaf blade is long and about twice as wide as the blade. That reads as a chunky ring beside a small leaf, not a 2 g fine band beside a mature sage leaf. a2 failed the same way; a4 is better (the leaf is ~1.4× longer relative to the ring) but not enough.
